items.name: Item: Passage GapFill
items.instructions: Fill in each of the missing words.
items.passage: Once upon a time, in a big [zoo], there was a little penguin named Pippin. Pippin was [black] and [white], just like all penguins, but he had a very big dream. Pippin thought he was not a penguin but a panda! Every day, he would watch the pandas eat [bamboo] and climb [tree]s. 'I want to do that too!' Pippin would say. The other penguins laughed. 'Penguins eat [fish] and swim in the [ocean], not climb [tree]s!' they said. But Pippin didn’t listen. One day, he found a piece of [bamboo]. 'This is my chance!' he thought. He tried to climb a [tree] with the [bamboo] in his beak. It was not easy! Pippin slipped and fell into the water. Splash! He laughed and swam happily. 'Maybe I am a penguin after all,' Pippin thought. And from that day on, Pippin was happy being his [black] and [white] self, swimming in the [ocean] and eating [fish] with his friends.

items.name: Item Audio Chat
items.instructions: Practice speaking with your AI partner.
items.text: Your AI partner will ask you some simple questions. Do your best to answer them clearly and briefly.
items.audiochattopic: Let’s talk about your home town or village.
items.audiochatinstructions:
You are {ai role}. Your name is Sam. You are helping the student practice speaking {target language}. The student is a native speaker of {native language}. The topic is: {topic}. Please ask the questions below to the student. Speak simply and slowly. Do not use difficult words. Your responses should be brief and use easy words. Your aim is to give the student opportunity to speak. Do not correct their language, but help them if they do not understand. When the student has answered all the questions, thank them and tell them to "press the end button." The questions are:
{ai data1}
items.audiochataidata1:
What kind of place is it?
What’s the most interesting part of your town/village?
What kind of jobs do the people in your town/village do?
Would you say it’s a good place to live? Tell me why you think that.
items.audiochatgradeinstructions: Give 5 points for each good answer to a question that was answered by the student. Give 3 points for relevant answers with mistakes. Give the student detailed feedback on their use of language, and on notable grammatical mistakes. Your comments should be in {native language} but do not translate quotes from the conversation and suggested corrections should be in {target language}. These are the questions: {ai data1}

items.name: Item: Free Speaking
items.instructions: Use the microphone to record your answer to the question.
items.text: If you were the penguin who thinks he is a panda, how would you explain to your penguin friends why you believe you are a panda?
items.aigradefeedback: Explain each grammar mistake in simple language. Do not comment on spelling or punctuation.
items.aigradeinstructions: Deduct 3 points for each grammar mistake. Do not penalize for spelling or punctuation errors.
